name: agent-callout
description: Give AI agents a pen for existing screenshots.

interface.shortDescription: Annotate screenshots for reviews and reports
interface.longDescription: Inspect and annotate existing screenshots with callouts, arrows, numbered findings, highlights, spotlight, blur, and irreversible redaction. Outputs a PNG, replayable JSON sidecar, hashes, warnings, and Markdown.
defaultPrompt: Annotate this screenshot and return Markdown-ready evidence.
Number the three issues in this screenshot and explain them.
Redact the token, blur the email, and verify the output.
